settings.text: Straight answers about the harness, sizing and delivery. Still stuck? Contact us, we reply within one business day, Sydney time.

settings.heading: Will it stop my dog pulling?
settings.row_content: Most dogs pull noticeably less on the first walk because pulling stops getting them anywhere. Some determined dogs take a few walks. That's why you get 60 days, not 60 minutes.

settings.heading: Is it a replacement for training?
settings.row_content: No. It's a control tool that removes the leverage while you teach loose-lead walking. We send you The First 10 Walks so the two work together.

settings.heading: What is the difference between the front and back clips?
settings.row_content: The front (chest) clip redirects a pull sideways, back towards you. Use it on busy paths and for training. The back clip lets your dog walk freely once the lead stays slack. Switch back to the front clip the moment pulling returns.

settings.heading: How do I measure my dog?
settings.row_content: Wrap a soft tape around the widest part of the ribcage, just behind the front legs. Snug, not tight. Then the neck, where a collar sits. Compare with the size guide.

settings.heading: What if my dog is between sizes?
settings.row_content: Go up. Thick double coat? Go up. Wrong size costs you nothing: free swap within 60 days.

settings.heading: Why can a harness twist?
settings.row_content: Twisting almost always means a size too big or the two sides tightened unevenly. Fit by chest, adjust both sides, two fingers under each strap. Steps in the fitting guide.

settings.heading: Can the straps loosen?
settings.row_content: Sliders can settle on the first walk. Re-check the belly strap after five minutes. If a strap keeps slipping after that, contact us; that's a fault and we replace it.

settings.heading: How long does delivery take?
settings.row_content: We ship within one business day. Australia Post standard (free): 2–4 business days metro, 3–6 regional, longer for remote WA and NT. Express (A$9.95): 1–3 business days.

settings.heading: What if I choose the wrong size?
settings.row_content: Email us within 60 days. We swap sizes free, one swap per order, prepaid both ways.

settings.heading: How does the 60-day guarantee work?
settings.row_content: If the harness hasn't changed your walks within 60 days of delivery, contact us with your order number. We send a prepaid Australia Post label and refund the full price once it's scanned in. Details on the guarantee page.

settings.heading: Do you have a phone number?
settings.row_content: Not yet. Email is fastest: contact us and we'll answer within one business day, Sydney time.
